message.subject: Collaboration idea with EDXSO
message.email_body: When teachers and school leaders struggle to build live dashboards without coding, your video on teaching AI business processes stood out. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership and sustainable institutional growth. We want to propose an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. This gives you a chance to develop useful content with an education consulting team and discuss a suitable collaboration format. Would you be interested in exploring this together?
